rationale: The failure might also stem from the workflow missing a post‑extraction check for collection libraries that would trigger a hard failure when the library has not been properly templatized. Adding a short, actionable check before the final validation step will cause the agent to reject a pack that would otherwise pass the universal schema, producing the expected `validate_failed` exit.
expected_effect: The new instruction forces the agent to check for missing scope on collection items before final validation. For a collection library that lacks scope, the agent will deliberately fail the validate step (or refuse to continue), producing the expected non‑zero exit in the t05‑collection test.
regression_risk: Libraries that are not collections will skip the check, so no impact. Existing collection libraries that already have scope will pass the extra step without change. The risk of an agent incorrectly identifying a library as ‘collection’ and forcing an unnecessary failure is mitigated because the check is only triggered when the library is recognised as a collection type.
